spans.s:
The affix ष्यञ् has after a word expressive of quality and after ब्राह्मण etc., the sense of the activity or occupation or something or someone.

Terms: ष्यञ्

Before a पित् सार्वधातुक affix which is a single consonant, गुण is substituted for the final of ऊर्णु ।

Terms: गुण

गुण is substituted for the final ऋ in the root ऋ (अर्ति) and in those roots ending in ऋ in which the vowel is preceded by a conjunct consonant, when the Passive character यक् or the Benedictive augment यास् follows.

Terms: गुण

गुण is substituted for the final of इ and उ (with their long) of a reduplicate when the Intensive character यङ् follows and also when it is elided.

Terms: Reduplicate
